title: Ankhorage Supabase Auth Adapter
summary: Implements the provider-neutral Ankhorage authentication port using Supabase Auth.
purpose: Translate portable authentication and session operations to Supabase while preserving the shared auth boundary.
responsibilities: Create a Supabase-backed authentication adapter from explicit configuration.
Implement password, session, profile, account-lifecycle, and supported OAuth operations.
Protect OAuth attempt state and map Supabase responses into shared auth contracts.
boundaries: Does not define the provider-neutral auth port or portable auth contracts.
Does not provision Supabase projects, credentials, callback URLs, or application sessions.
Does not own provider-independent authorization policy.
audience: Applications selecting Supabase Auth behind the Ankhorage auth port.
Composition code requiring a configured provider-neutral authentication adapter.
useCases: Authenticate and manage sessions with Supabase through the shared auth port.
Start and complete supported OAuth flows with replay-resistant attempt state.
Perform supported account and profile lifecycle operations.

architecture.role: Outbound provider adapter translating Ankhorage auth operations to Supabase Auth.
invariants: The public factory returns the provider-neutral authentication boundary.
OAuth state is validated before callback completion.
Supabase-specific transport and error details do not escape the adapter contract.

limitations: Requires a configured and reachable Supabase Auth project.
Available OAuth and account operations depend on Supabase provider configuration.
